BOOK3_LESSON_FOURTEEN_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–3 · The Story of the Double Seventh Festival

text.traditional: 你這個布做的錢包好漂亮，在哪裡買的？
text.simplified: 你这个布做的钱包好漂亮，在哪里买的？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bù zuò de qiánbāo hǎo piàoliàng, zài nǎlǐ mǎi de?
text.english: This cloth wallet of yours is so pretty. Where did you buy it?

text.traditional: 是我女朋友親手做的七夕情人節禮物。法國也有情人節吧？
text.simplified: 是我女朋友亲手做的七夕情人节礼物。法国也有情人节吧？
text.pinyin: Shì wǒ nǚpéngyǒu qīnshǒu zuò de Qīxī Qíngrénjié lǐwù. Fǎguó yě yǒu Qíngrénjié ba?
text.english: It's a Qixi Valentine's gift handmade by my girlfriend. France has Valentine's Day too, right?

text.traditional: 有啊，不過不是在七夕。你們這個節日背後應該有故事吧？
text.simplified: 有啊，不过不是在七夕。你们这个节日背后应该有故事吧？
text.pinyin: Yǒu a, búguò búshì zài Qīxī. Nǐmen zhège jiérì bèihòu yīnggāi yǒu gùshì ba?
text.english: Yes, but not on Qixi. There must be a story behind your festival, right?

text.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。從前有個叫牛郎的青年，每天都帶著老牛去田裡工作。有一天，他在河邊休息時，看見了一位非常美麗的姑娘。
text.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。从前有个叫牛郎的青年，每天都带着老牛去田里工作。有一天，他在河边休息时，看见了一位非常美丽的姑娘。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le. Cóngqián yǒu ge jiào Niúláng de qīngnián, měitiān dōu dài zhe lǎo niú qù tián lǐ gōngzuò. Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài hébiān xiūxí shí, kànjiàn le yí wèi fēicháng měilì de gūniáng.
text.english: To explain that, we have to start with Niulang and Weaver Girl. Once there was a young man named Niulang who took his old ox to work the fields every day. One day while resting by the river, he saw an exceptionally beautiful girl.

text.traditional: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就覺得遇到了真愛吧。
text.simplified: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就觉得遇到了真爱吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cāi Niúláng dì yī yǎn kàndào tā, jiù juéde yùdào le zhēn'ài ba.
text.english: I bet the very first moment Niulang saw her, he felt he had found true love.

text.traditional: 是啊。那個天真可愛的姑娘名叫織女，她是天上的仙女，跟著幾個姊姊來人間玩，過幾天就得回到天上。
text.simplified: 是啊。那个天真可爱的姑娘名叫织女，她是天上的仙女，跟着几个姊姊来人间玩，过几天就得回到天上。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Nàge tiānzhēn kě'ài de gūniáng míng jiào Zhīnǚ, tā shì tiānshàng de xiānnǚ, gēn zhe jǐ ge jiějie lái rénjiān wán, guò jǐ tiān jiù děi huídào tiānshàng.
text.english: Indeed. That innocent and lovely girl was named Weaver Girl. She was a celestial fairy from heaven, visiting the mortal world with her older sisters for fun, and had to return to heaven after a few days.

text.traditional: 牛郎不想把她留下來嗎？
text.simplified: 牛郎不想把她留下来吗？
text.pinyin: Niúláng bù xiǎng bǎ tā liú xià lái ma?
text.english: Didn't Niulang want to keep her here?

text.traditional: 當然想啊！為了把織女留在身邊，牛郎就拿走了能讓織女飛回天上的衣服。後來，因為牛郎很溫柔、很體貼，織女就慢慢愛上他了，最後他們成了夫婦，還生了兩個寶貝。
text.simplified: 当然想啊！为了把织女留在身边，牛郎就拿走了能让织女飞回天上的衣服。后来，因为牛郎很温柔、很体贴，织女就慢慢爱上他了，最后他们成了夫妇，还生了两个宝贝。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng a! Wèile bǎ Zhīnǚ liú zài shēnbiān, Niúláng jiù ná zǒu le néng ràng Zhīnǚ fēi huí tiānshàng de yīfu. Hòulái, yīnwèi Niúláng hěn wēnróu, hěn tǐtiē, Zhīnǚ jiù mànmàn àishàng tā le, zuìhòu tāmen chéng le fūfù, hái shēng le liǎng ge bǎobèi.
text.english: Of course he did! To keep Weaver Girl by his side, Niulang took away the clothes that allowed her to fly back to heaven. Later, because Niulang was gentle and thoughtful, Weaver Girl gradually fell in love with him, and eventually they became husband and wife and had two precious children.

text.traditional: 他們就這樣過著幸福快樂的日子嗎？
text.simplified: 他们就这样过着幸福快乐的日子吗？
text.pinyin: Tāmen jiù zhèyàng guò zhe xìngfú kuàilè de rìzi ma?
text.english: And did they live happily ever after just like that?

text.traditional: 唉，沒那麼簡單。天帝知道了以後，氣得叫王母娘娘把織女抓回天上，還把她關了起來。牛郎找來找去，總算在天上某個神祕的地方找到了織女。沒想到王母娘娘卻在他們中間變出一條銀河，讓他們只能遠遠地看著對方。
text.simplified: 唉，没那么简单。天帝知道了以后，气得叫王母娘娘把织女抓回天上，还把她关了起来。牛郎找来找去，总算在天上某个神秘的地方找到了织女。没想到王母娘娘却在他们中间变出一条银河，让他们只能远远地看着对方。
text.pinyin: Āi, méi nàme jiǎndān. Tiāndì zhīdào le yǐhòu, qì de jiào Wángmǔ Niángniang bǎ Zhīnǚ zhuā huí tiānshàng, hái bǎ tā guān le qǐlái. Niúláng zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zǒngsuàn zài tiānshàng mǒu ge shénmì de dìfāng zhǎodào le Zhīnǚ. Méixiǎngdào Wángmǔ Niángniang què zài tāmen zhōngjiān biàn chū yì tiáo Yínhé, ràng tāmen zhǐ néng yuǎnyuǎn de kàn zhe duìfāng.
text.english: Alas, it wasn't so simple. When the Heavenly Emperor found out, he was furious and ordered the Queen Mother of the West to drag Weaver Girl back to heaven and lock her up. Niulang searched everywhere and finally found Weaver Girl in a mysterious place in heaven. Unexpectedly, the Queen Mother conjured up the Milky Way between them, allowing them only to gaze at each other from afar.

text.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
text.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
text.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bùnéng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bùnéng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
text.english: Weaver Girl couldn't be together with Niulang, nor could she live on in the mortal world; how pitiful.

text.traditional: 還好姊姊們很同情她，好幾次請求王母娘娘幫忙。王母娘娘仔細觀察了兩人的情況，終於被他們的愛情感動了，答應讓他們在每年的農曆七月初七見面。有人說，七夕年年都會下雨，那就是織女流下的眼淚。
text.simplified: 还好姊姊们很同情她，好几次请求王母娘娘帮忙。王母娘娘仔细观察了两人的情况，终于被他们的爱情感动了，答应让他们在每年的农历七月初七见面。有人说，七夕年年都会下雨，那就是织女流下的眼泪。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo jiějie men hěn tóngqíng tā, hǎojǐ cì qǐngqiú Wángmǔ Niángniang bāngmáng. Wángmǔ Niángniang zǐxì guānchá le liǎng rén de qíngkuàng, zhōngyú bèi tāmen de àiqíng gǎndòng le, dāyìng ràng tāmen zài měinián de nónglì qīyuè chū qī jiànmiàn. Yǒu rén shuō, Qīxī niánnián dōu huì xiàyǔ, nà jiùshì Zhīnǚ liú xià de yǎnlèi.
text.english: Fortunately her sisters sympathized with her and begged the Queen Mother repeatedly for help. The Queen Mother carefully observed the couple's situation and was finally moved by their love, granting them permission to meet every year on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month. Some say that it rains every year on Qixi, and that is Weaver Girl shedding tears.

text.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
text.simplified: 幸亏有姊姊们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
text.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějie men de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bùnéng tuányuán le.
text.english: Fortunately they had the sisters' help, otherwise they would never have reunited in their entire lives.

text.traditional: 可是一年只能見一次面，這樣的結局讓我很難過。
text.simplified: 可是一年只能见一次面，这样的结局让我很难过。
text.pinyin: Kěshì yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn yí cì miàn, zhèyàng de jiéjú ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
text.english: But meeting only once a year—such an ending makes me sad.

text.traditional: 怎麼說呢？
text.simplified: 怎么说呢？
text.pinyin: Zěnme shuō ne?
text.english: Why do you say that?

text.traditional: 我女朋友畢業後就要出國念書，我擔心兩個人分開太久，關係就變淡了。
text.simplified: 我女朋友毕业后就要出国念书，我担心两个人分开太久，关系就变淡了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǚpéngyǒu bìyè hòu jiùyào chūguó niànshū, wǒ dānxīn liǎng ge rén fēnkāi tài jiǔ, guānxì jiù biàn dàn le.
text.english: My girlfriend is going abroad to study after graduation. I worry that being apart too long will cause our relationship to fade.

text.traditional: 別擔心，現在網路這麼方便，隨時都能聊天、傳照片，距離再遠也沒問題。
text.simplified: 别担心，现在网路这么方便，随时都能聊天、传照片，距离再远也没问题。
text.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, xiànzài wǎnglù zhème fāngbiàn, suíshí dōu néng liáotiān, chuán zhàopiàn, jùlí zài yuǎn yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Don't worry. The internet is so convenient now; you can chat and send photos anytime. No matter how far the distance, it won't be a problem.

text.traditional: 沒問題倒是沒問題，不過遠距離的戀愛還是很辛苦的。
text.simplified: 没问题倒是没问题，不过远距离的恋爱还是很辛苦的。
text.pinyin: Méi wèntí dàoshì méi wèntí, búguò yuǎnjùlí de liàn'ài háishì hěn xīnkǔ de.
text.english: It's true that it's not a problem, but a long-distance relationship is still really hard.

text.traditional: 別想那麼多了，你還是說說跟七夕有關的習俗吧。
text.simplified: 别想那么多了，你还是说说跟七夕有关的习俗吧。
text.pinyin: Bié xiǎng nàme duō le, nǐ háishì shuōshuo gēn Qīxī yǒuguān de xísú ba.
text.english: Don't overthink it; why not tell me about customs related to Qixi instead?

text.traditional: 好吧。七夕那天，當月亮升起時，就會有拜織女的活動。因為織女織布的技巧很好，能織出漂亮的衣服和美麗的雲。人間的姑娘希望能像她那樣又聰明又漂亮，就會用一些親手做的東西來拜她。
text.simplified: 好吧。七夕那天，当月亮升起时，就会有拜织女的活动。因为织女织布的技巧很好，能织出漂亮的衣服和美丽的云。人间的姑娘希望能像她那样又聪明又漂亮，就会用一些亲手做的东西来拜她。
text.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Qīxī nà tiān, dāng yuèliàng shēngqǐ shí, jiù huì yǒu bài Zhīnǚ de huódòng. Yīnwèi Zhīnǚ zhībù de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, néng zhī chū piàoliàng de yīfu hé měilì de yún. Rénjiān de gūniáng xīwàng néng xiàng tā nàyàng yòu cōngmíng yòu piàoliàng, jiù huì yòng yìxiē qīnshǒu zuò de dōngxi lái bài tā.
text.english: All right. On Qixi day, when the moon rises, there are activities honoring Weaver Girl. Because Weaver Girl was very good at weaving, she could weave beautiful clothes and lovely clouds. Girls in the mortal world who hope to be as clever and pretty as she was worship her with things they have made by hand.

text.traditional: 你女朋友在七夕送你這個親手做的錢包，原來有特別的意義啊！
text.simplified: 你女朋友在七夕送你这个亲手做的钱包，原来有特别的意义啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ nǚpéngyǒu zài Qīxī sòng nǐ zhège qīnshǒu zuò de qiánbāo, yuánlái yǒu tèbié de yìyì a!
text.english: So your girlfriend giving you this handmade wallet on Qixi carries a special meaning after all!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Starting to explain/narrate from a specific point
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something can't be explained simply and has to start from a certain point, with (這)就要從……說起了 (說 can also be 看, 找, 做…).
grammarPages.explanation: 本課對話中使用「（這）就要從……說起了」，表示說話者提到的某件事，沒辦法簡單說清楚，得從某個角度、部分或時間開始說，才能讓聽者明白。這個「說」可換成「看、做、寫、找、談、講、聊」等單音節動詞，表示開始做那件事。假如前句已提到主題，就不需用「這/那」。
grammarPages.pattern: (這) + 就要從 + Starting point + Verb (說/看/找…) + 起了

text.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。……
text.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。……
text.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le.…
text.english: To explain that, we have to start with the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl…

text.traditional: 這個計畫一再地調整內容，想找到舊資料的話，就要從兩年前的找起了。
text.simplified: 这个计划一再地调整内容，想找到旧资料的话，就要从两年前的找起了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge jìhuà yízài de tiáozhěng nèiróng, xiǎng zhǎodào jiù zīliào dehuà, jiùyào cóng liǎng nián qián de zhǎo qǐ le.
text.english: This plan's content has been changed again and again, so if you want to find the old files, you'll have to start looking with the ones from two years ago.

text.traditional:
A：我花了很多錢去健身房運動，怎麼過了三個月還沒變瘦？
B：這就要從你的飲食習慣說起了。要是你不改掉愛吃零食的壞習慣，怎麼瘦得下來呢？
text.simplified:
A：我花了很多钱去健身房运动，怎么过了三个月还没变瘦？
B：这就要从你的饮食习惯说起了。要是你不改掉爱吃零食的坏习惯，怎么瘦得下来呢？
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ huā le hěn duō qián qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, zěnme guò le sān ge yuè háiméi biàn shòu?
B: Zhè jiùyào cóng nǐ de yǐnshí xíguàn shuōqǐ le. Yàoshì nǐ bù gǎidiào ài chī língshí de huài xíguàn, zěnme shòu de xiàlái ne?
text.english:
A: I've spent a lot of money going to the gym, so how come I still haven't lost weight after three months?
B: For that, we have to start with your eating habits. If you don't break your bad habit of snacking, how will you ever lose weight?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In the dialogue in this lesson, （這）就要從……說起了 means that something mentioned by the speaker cannot be easily stated clearly. You must start from a certain angle, part or time to make the listener understand. “Speak” can be replaced with a single-syllable verb such as “see, do, write, find, discuss, speak, chat”, which means to begin that action. If the subject is mentioned in the previous sentence, “this/that” is not necessary.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone keeps on doing something, or can or can't keep going, with V下去, V得下去 and V不下去.
grammarPages.explanation: 「下去」放在動詞之後，當作補語，表示某個動作繼續進行，「V下去」後面不可加賓語。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 下去 / 得下去 / 不下去

text.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
text.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
text.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bùnéng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bùnéng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
text.english: The Weaver Girl could not be together with the Cowherd, and could not keep living in the human world either. How pitiful.

text.traditional: 這部電影很無聊，演員的演戲技巧也不好，我實在看不下去了。
text.simplified: 这部电影很无聊，演员的演戏技巧也不好，我实在看不下去了。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn wúliáo, yǎnyuán de yǎnxì jìqiǎo yě bùhǎo, wǒ shízài kàn bú xiàqù le.
text.english: This movie is boring, and the actors' acting isn't good either. I really can't keep watching it.

text.traditional:
A：總統給你們的任務很危險，你們能堅持下去嗎？
B：我們是軍人，為了國家，就算犧牲生命也必須完成。
text.simplified:
A：总统给你们的任务很危险，你们能坚持下去吗？
B：我们是军人，为了国家，就算牺牲生命也必须完成。
text.pinyin:
A: Zǒngtǒng gěi nǐmen de rènwù hěn wéixiǎn, nǐmen néng jiānchí xiàqù ma?
B: Wǒmen shì jūnrén, wèile guójiā, jiùsuàn xīshēng shēngmìng yě bìxū wánchéng.
text.english:
A: The task the president gave you is very dangerous. Can you keep going?
B: We are soldiers; for the country, we must complete it even if we sacrifice our lives.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 下去 is placed after the verb and used as a complement to indicate that a certain action continues. No object can be added after “V 下去”.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain how a lucky circumstance prevented a terrible outcome from happening.
grammarPages.explanation: 「幸虧」是副詞，後面敘述某個因為很幸運而發生的事件，要是沒有這個事件，「要不然」後面不好的、擔心的情況就會出現。
grammarPages.pattern: 幸虧 + Fortunate event, + 要不然 + Negative outcome

text.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
text.simplified: 幸亏有姊姊们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
text.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějie men de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bùnéng tuányuán le.
text.english: Luckily the older sisters helped; otherwise they could never have been reunited in their lifetime.

text.traditional: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺廟前天忽然塌了，幸虧她那天沒去，要不然就糟了。
text.simplified: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺庙前天忽然塌了，幸亏她那天没去，要不然就糟了。
text.pinyin: Nǎinai tiāntiān qù bàibài de nà zuò sìmiào qiántiān hūrán tā le, xìngkuī tā nà tiān méi qù, yàobùrán jiù zāo le.
text.english: The temple where Grandma goes to pray every day suddenly collapsed the day before yesterday. Luckily she didn't go that day; otherwise it would have been terrible.

text.traditional: 錢先生發生嚴重車禍時，幸虧警察就在路邊，趕快把他送到了醫院，要不然他的命就沒了。
text.simplified: 钱先生发生严重车祸时，幸亏警察就在路边，赶快把他送到了医院，要不然他的命就没了。
text.pinyin: Qián xiānshēng fāshēng yánzhòng chēhuò shí, xìngkuī jǐngchá jiù zài lùbiān, gǎnkuài bǎ tā sòng dào le yīyuàn, yàobùrán tā de mìng jiù méi le.
text.english: When Mr. Qian had a serious car accident, luckily a police officer was right by the road and quickly took him to the hospital; otherwise he would have died.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 幸虧 is an adverb. The statement after 幸虧 describes an event that happened because of luck. If there is no such event, the bad and worrisome situation behind 要不然 will appear.

BOOK3_LESSON_FOURTEEN_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 4–5 · The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day

dialogue.title: 短文 · 情人節的意義
grammarFocus: 按照 / 按 / 照 NP + V

text.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人們就會想到牛郎和織女的愛情故事。這個故事不是真的，不過大家對愛情還是有無窮的想像，希望在現實中能夠擁有最美好的愛情。
text.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人们就会想到牛郎和织女的爱情故事。这个故事不是真的，不过大家对爱情还是有无穷的想像，希望在现实中能够拥有最美好的爱情。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de “Qīxī”. Yì tídào Qīxī, rénmen jiù huì xiǎngdào Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de àiqíng gùshì. Zhège gùshì búshì zhēnde, búguò dàjiā duì àiqíng háishì yǒu wú qióng de xiǎngxiàng, xīwàng zài xiànshí zhōng nénggòu yǒngyǒu zuì měihǎo de àiqíng.
text.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is known as "Qixi". Whenever Qixi is mentioned, people think of the love story of Niulang and Weaver Girl. This story isn't true, but people still have endless imagination about love and hope to have the most beautiful love in real life.

text.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友，向對方表達心意。後來，商人抓到了這個能創造更多利益的機會，就在七夕和西方情人節這兩個節日，推銷屬於情人節的特別禮物。不僅戀愛中的男女願意花錢買，平時只有以網路聊天、寫信等方式談戀愛的情侶，也會在這天送禮。但是某一些商業廣告強調，情人節交換禮物是愛對方的表現，也是情侶之間該有的責任。讓很多人以為不送禮、不約會是個錯誤，而犯了錯的人就得道歉。其實只要對情人是真心的，送不送禮物沒那麼重要，畢竟單純的愛情才是最珍貴的。
text.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友，向对方表达心意。后来，商人抓到了这个能创造更多利益的机会，就在七夕和西方情人节这两个节日，推销属于情人节的特别礼物。不仅恋爱中的男女愿意花钱买，平时只有以网路聊天、写信等方式谈恋爱的情侣，也会在这天送礼。但是某一些商业广告强调，情人节交换礼物是爱对方的表现，也是情侣之间该有的责任。让很多人以为不送礼、不约会是个错误，而犯了错的人就得道歉。其实只要对情人是真心的，送不送礼物没那么重要，毕竟单纯的爱情才是最珍贵的。
text.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxi sòng gěi péngyǒu, xiàng duìfāng biǎodá xīnyì. Hòulái, shāngrén zhuā dào le zhège néng chuàngzào gèng duō lìyì de jīhuì, jiù zài Qīxī hé xīfāng Qíngrénjié zhè liǎng ge jiérì, tuīxiāo shǔyú Qíngrénjié de tèbié lǐwù. Bù jǐn liàn'ài zhōng de nánnǚ yuànyì huāqián mǎi, píngshí zhǐyǒu yǐ wǎnglù liáotiān, xiěxìn děng fāngshì tán liàn'ài de qínglǚ, yě huì zài zhè tiān sònglǐ. Dànshì mǒu yìxiē shāngyè guǎnggào qiángdiào, Qíngrénjié jiāohuàn lǐwù shì ài duìfāng de biǎoxiàn, yě shì qínglǚ zhījiān gāi yǒu de zérèn. Ràng hěn duō rén yǐwéi bú sònglǐ, bù yuēhuì shì ge cuòwù, ér fàn le cuò de rén jiù děi dàoqiàn. Qíshí zhǐyào duì qíngrén shì zhēnxīn de, sòng bú sòng lǐwù méi nàme zhòngyào, bìjìng dānchún de àiqíng cái shì zuì zhēnguì de.
text.english: According to past customs, young maidens would give handmade trinkets to friends on Qixi to express their affection. Later, merchants seized upon this opportunity to create greater profits, promoting special Valentine gifts during both Qixi and Western Valentine's Day. Not only were courting couples eager to spend money, but couples who usually date only through online chatting, letters and the like would also send gifts on this day. However, certain commercial advertisements emphasized that exchanging gifts on Valentine's Day proves one's love and is an obligation between lovers. This led many to believe that not giving gifts or going on dates is a misstep requiring an apology. In reality, as long as one is sincere toward their beloved, whether gifts are given is not so critical—after all, pure love is what is truly precious.

text.traditional: 不過話說回來，像牛郎與織女這樣的愛情故事，還是感動了無數人。不少文學與戲劇都採用這類的題材，畫家也常透過作品來表達浪漫的愛情。如能花點時間欣賞這方面的作品，或許就能更深入了解情人節的意義了。
text.simplified: 不过话说回来，像牛郎与织女这样的爱情故事，还是感动了无数人。不少文学与戏剧都采用这类的题材，画家也常透过作品来表达浪漫的爱情。如能花点时间欣赏这方面的作品，或许就能更深入了解情人节的意义了。
text.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, xiàng Niúláng yǔ Zhīnǚ zhèyàng de àiqíng gùshì, háishì gǎndòng le wúshù rén. Bùshǎo wénxué yǔ xìjù dōu cǎiyòng zhè lèi de tícái, huàjiā yě cháng tòuguò zuòpǐn lái biǎodá làngmàn de àiqíng. Rú néng huā diǎn shíjiān xīnshǎng zhè fāngmiàn de zuòpǐn, huòxǔ jiù néng gèng shēnrù liǎojiě Qíngrénjié de yìyì le.
text.english: Then again, love stories like Niulang and Weaver Girl still touch countless hearts. Many literary works and dramas adopt themes of this kind, and painters frequently convey romantic love through their art. If one can take some time to appreciate works in this domain, perhaps one will gain a deeper understanding of Valentine's true meaning.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day
grammarPages.titleEnglish: According to / Based on (basis or evidence)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what a statement, decision or conclusion is based on (a report, survey, law, experience…) with 根據.
grammarPages.explanation: 「根據」是介詞，意思是用某個行為、情況、資料、研究結果等當作基礎，做出判斷、行動或結論。「根據」的後面接名詞短語，常使用的名詞如：報告、調查、經驗、法律、規定、情況、了解、看法、結果、說明等等。
grammarPages.pattern: 根據 + Basis (Source / Law / Report / Survey), + Claim

text.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。
text.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de “Qīxī”.
text.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is what is known as Qixi.

text.traditional: 根據我國的法律，十八歲以上才可以喝酒。
text.simplified: 根据我国的法律，十八岁以上才可以喝酒。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù wǒguó de fǎlǜ, shíbā suì yǐshàng cái kěyǐ hē jiǔ.
text.english: According to our country's law, you have to be 18 or older to drink alcohol.

text.traditional: 根據氣象調查的資料，全球溫度比以前高了兩度，也因此造成了一些環境問題。
text.simplified: 根据气象调查的资料，全球温度比以前高了两度，也因此造成了一些环境问题。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng diàochá de zīliào, quánqiú wēndù bǐ yǐqián gāo le liǎng dù, yě yīncǐ zàochéng le yìxiē huánjìng wèntí.
text.english: According to the meteorological survey data, global temperature has risen two degrees compared with before, which has also caused some environmental problems.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 根據 is a preposition, making relevant conclusions based on certain behaviors, research results, stories or materials. After 根據, the words often used together are 報告, 調查, 經驗, 法律, 規定, 情況, 了解 看法, 結果, 說明, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day
grammarPages.titleEnglish: In accordance with / Following (method or rule)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify the rule, custom, plan, or instruction followed when performing an action.
grammarPages.explanation: 「按照」是介詞，意思是以某種方法、要求、規定、計畫、決定、標準等來做事情。「按照」主要強調「怎麼做」，例如：咖啡的價錢是按照杯子大小算的、薪水是按照在公司地位的高低決定的。「按照」可以只用「按」或「照」；「根據」則強調「為什麼這麼說、這麼做；為什麼有這樣的結論」，例如：根據臺灣的升學制度，想進好大學就得通過大學考試。「根據」也可以當名詞，例如：網路上有很多訊息是沒有根據的，不能完全相信。
grammarPages.pattern: 按照 / 按 / 照 + Standard + Action

text.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友……
text.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友……
text.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxi sòng gěi péngyǒu…
text.english: Following past custom, girls would give the little things they made by hand to their friends on Qixi…

text.traditional:
A：怎麼辦？奶奶忽然生病住院了。
B：別擔心，只要按照醫生的話去做，應該可以很快出院的。
text.simplified:
A：怎么办？奶奶忽然生病住院了。
B：别担心，只要按照医生的话去做，应该可以很快出院的。
text.pinyin:
A: Zěnmebàn? Nǎinai hūrán shēngbìng zhùyuàn le.
B: Bié dānxīn, zhǐyào ànzhào yīshēng de huà qù zuò, yīnggāi kěyǐ hěn kuài chūyuàn de.
text.english:
A: What should we do? Grandma suddenly got sick and is in the hospital.
B: Don't worry. As long as she does what the doctor says, she should be able to leave the hospital soon.

text.traditional:
助理：下個月的員工訓練，要怎麼做呢？
老闆：昨天已經開過主管會議了，就按會議的決定做吧。
text.simplified:
助理：下个月的员工训练，要怎么做呢？
老板：昨天已经开过主管会议了，就按会议的决定做吧。
text.pinyin:
Zhùlǐ: Xià ge yuè de yuángōng xùnliàn, yào zěnme zuò ne?
Lǎobǎn: Zuótiān yǐjīng kāi guò zhǔguǎn huìyì le, jiù àn huìyì de juédìng zuò ba.
text.english:
Assistant\: How should we run next month's staff training?
Boss: We already held the managers' meeting yesterday, so just do it the way the meeting decided.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 按照 is a preposition. It means to do things according to certain methods, requirements, regulations, plans, decisions, and standards. “According to” mainly emphasizes “how to do it”. For example, 咖啡的價錢是按照杯子大小算的，薪水是按照在公司地位的高低決定的. 按照 can only use 按 or 照; 根據 emphasizes “why you say so and do this; why there is such a conclusion”. For example, 根據臺灣的升學制度，想進好大學就得通過大學考試. 根據 can also be used as a noun. For example, 網路上有很多訊息是沒有根據的，不能完全相信。
